name: Unlucky For Some 2013, Show I: Louisville

date.source: The show's own title-history-cited date; the full show script itself was posted 3 March 2015, two years after the event it recounts.

matches.stipulation: Hardcore rules; BookFace's non-sanctioned WREX Hardcore Championship on the line
Intergalactic Team Championships of the Universe qualifying match
matches.note: Keith Scalzo pinned Ultrajira with the Sam Kenison, a wheelbarrow release suplex; a later card's recap (the Hot Springs card release) also gives Funicide the win.

notes: The show also carried a backstage confrontation between Phil Atken and commissioner Morton Murphy, a comedic vignette from the tag team the Haughty Trope, and a backstage interview with Leyenda de Ocho conducted by Sandra Dee -- none staged as a match and none structured.

name: Unlucky For Some 2013, Show II: Hot Springs

date.source: The card-release thread's own posting date

no_appearances_reason: Only the fed's own pre-show card release is held; its own results thread was not found in the held record read. The announced entrants are not minted on the strength of a lineup announcement alone.
notes: Announced main event: Sylo vs. Leyenda de Ocho, an Intergalactic Championship qualifier continuing the pair's staredown from Show I. The card also announced further Intergalactic Championship qualifiers (Xoesh the Zith vs. Max Pierce; Raucous vs. Frank Hendrix vs. Todd Killings) and two more Intergalactic Team Championships of the Universe qualifiers (Triangle of Tyranny vs. Point of View; Monsters of the Pacific vs. Los Planetarios). The operator's own follow-up post reports 16 of a possible 22 roleplays were completed for the card.

name: Unlucky For Some 2013, Show III: Baton Rouge

date.source: The card-release thread's own posting date

no_appearances_reason: Only the fed's own pre-show card release is held; its own results thread was not found in the held record read. The announced entrants are not minted on the strength of a lineup announcement alone.
notes: Announced main event: a trios match pairing Leyenda de Ocho with special guests against the Triangle of Tyranny. The card also announced the returning former champion Phil Atken against Raucous, and further Intergalactic Championship qualifiers (Skylar Montgomery vs. Xoesh the Zith; Ikan Jobtayoo vs. BookFace, rematched over the non-sanctioned WREX Hardcore Championship; Todd Killings vs. Jesse Ramey) alongside an Intergalactic Team Championships of the Universe qualifier for the Haughty Trope. The operator extended the roleplay window to 4 April 2013 for Easter.

name: Organised Chaos

date.source: The fed's own results podcast, first post; the show was staged in Richmond, Virginia.

matches.stipulation: Intergalactic Championship qualifying match (fatal three-way, no disqualification, no count-outs, no holds barred); Lane Cash did not arrive
matches.note: Troy Matthews pinned Christopher Ryan Eagles with the Trendsetter after Saori Kazama helped him turn the sledgehammer.
Leyenda de Ocho won with the Actualizar on Eddie Whisky and Steve Jackson; the fed's own forum correction names Steve Jackson as the man pinned.

notes: Billed as the Commission's second event; the commentators were Harry Balkin and Ikan Jobtayoo. The results complete the field of four for the ULTRATITLE finale. The first half of the card was the touring roster's.

name: Sorry You're Not a Winner

date.source: The fed's own results podcast, first post; the show was staged in Ocean City, Maryland.

matches.note: Magnus Destructo pinned Aran Thompson with the Destructo Bomb.

matches.stipulation: Intergalactic Championship qualifying match (tables, ladders and chairs; a briefcase with a title-shot contract hung over the concrete beside the ring)
matches.note: Leyenda de Ocho took the briefcase after an Actualizar from the top of a ladder onto Sylo.

title: igc-intergalactic
matches.note: The referee was knocked down and Phil Atken retained by rolling Magnus Destructo up with a handful of tights.

notes: The Commission's third event and the first defence of Phil Atken's reign; Magnus Destructo wrestled twice in the night. Commentary was by Morton Murphy and August Monday.

name: V for Victoralicious

date.source: The fed's own results podcast, first post; the show was staged at the Palumbo Center, Pittsburgh.

matches.stipulation: Intergalactic Championship qualifying match (the first of the two wins required in 2013)
matches.note: Xoesh the Zith won with the Saedomoen Clutch after hitting Raucous with a trash can lid.

matches.stipulation: Monster's Ball match (weapons allowed; both men were kept in solitary confinement for 24 hours first)
matches.note: Magnus Destructo won with a mace and the Destructo Bomb; security and police pulled the two apart.

title: igc-intergalactic
matches.stipulation: Three Stages of Zelda; Intergalactic Championship (Phil Atken defending): a Ganon Rules cage match, a Hyrule Castle ladder match and a Skyward Sword scaffold match
matches.note: Phil Atken took the second and third stages and retained, biting his challenger's wrist on the scaffold; Leyenda de Ocho had taken the first stage.

notes: Commentary was by Harry Balkin and pain GRILLE, with the Haughty Troupe filling in after Balkin's nose was broken; the host was Morton Murphy. The tour that followed opened at Louisville.

name: Wrestlesaurus Rex on ESEN: the pilot

date.source: The line-up thread, first post; the pilot was scheduled for 31 July 2012.

notes: The line-up thread for the Commission's television spin-off carries the card (Steve Jackson against Adam MacLeod, the Sons of Tradition against the Haughty Troupe, and Phil Atken against a mystery opponent); the results are not held. The Louisville card describes the spin-off as short-lived.

date.source: The fed's own results podcast, first post; the show was staged in Greensboro, North Carolina.

matches.stipulation: Intergalactic Championship qualifying match (two falls: tag team rules, then the winners face each other)
matches.note: ACW's Jack Harris and Kenjiro Ito lost the first fall to INFINITE's pair; Phil Atken then made Max Hopper submit to the figure four.
Sabre won with the Wrathful Strike.

matches.stipulation: Open challenge; the winner banked an Intergalactic Championship title shot
matches.note: Hornet won with the Scorpion Deathlock.
